text.p: Despite the perception that some spinners have appreciable raw cotton requirements to cover over the coming months, most continued to approach fresh business with caution, industry sources said.
On the other hand, the rise of the New York futures market yesterday effectively dissuaded trade sellers to concede ground on price.
That attitude was also reinforced by the greater uncertainty now surrounding the outlook as regards the availability and quality of supplies from the maturing northern hemisphere crops.
In this connection, attention is already turning to Friday's September crop and supply and demand estimates from Washington, the sources said.
